strings.settings_screens_import_csv_heading: Import trips from a CSV file
strings.settings_screens_import_csv_description: Supports this app\'s own CSV export format (Trip Name, Destination, Country, Departure City, Departure Date, Return Date, Transportation, Notes). You\'ll be able to review what will be imported before anything is saved.
strings.settings_screens_import_polarsteps_descr: Choose the trip export ZIP file Polarsteps generates from its app (Trip menu > Export trip). A multi-country trip is split into one entry per country and linked together. You\'ll be able to review what will be imported before anything is saved.
strings.settings_screens_import_calendar_scan_de: We\'ll look for upcoming flight and hotel bookings on your calendar. Nothing is added until you review and confirm it - and no calendar data ever leaves your device.
strings.settings_screens_import_calendar_no_matc: We didn\'t find any flight or hotel bookings on your calendar. If you expected to see one, make sure calendar access is allowed in your device Settings and try again.
strings.settings_screens_paywall_winback_message: Pick up right where you left off — your Premium features are still here for you.
strings.settings_screens_paywall_sync_error_note: Note: Using local cache. Your existing purchases are safe.
strings.settings_screens_crash_reporting_subtitl: Help us improve by sending anonymous crash data
strings.settings_screens_signin_description: Sign in to make it easier to restore your Premium purchase on a new device. Your trips, photos, and documents always stay only on this device - signing in never syncs or uploads any of your travel data.
strings.settings_screens_unesco_caption: A site counts as visited once you\'ve logged a trip to its country - this is a country-level check, not proof you stood at the exact landmark.
strings.settings_screens_unesco_summary_a11y: %1$d of %2$d UNESCO sites\' countries visited, %3$d%% complete
strings.settings_screens_year_review_error_descr: Something went wrong building your summary.
strings.settings_screens_year_review_title_slide: Swipe to look back at all the miles, memories, and milestones from this year.
strings.settings_screens_year_review_celebrate_s: Here\'s to many more unforgettable destinations ahead!
strings.settings_screens_year_review_no_trips_de: You don\'t have any trips logged for %1$d yet. This summary is based on trips logged between Jan 1 and Dec 31 of the selected year.
strings.settings_screens_year_recap_pick_card: Pick a card and share it to your story
strings.settings_screens_notification_allow_subt: All reminders are scheduled on this device.
strings.settings_screens_notification_on_device_: Reminders are scheduled on your device. Nothing about your trips is sent to a server.
strings.settings_screens_offline_maps_locked_mes: Offline map downloads are a Premium feature
strings.settings_screens_offline_maps_empty: Add a trip to download its destination for offline use
strings.settings_screens_offline_maps_download_f: Couldn\'t download this map. Check your connection and try again.
strings.settings_screens_offline_maps_unsupporte: Offline map downloads aren\'t available on iOS - Apple Maps has no public API for pre-downloading map regions.
strings.settings_screens_offline_maps_delete_fai: Couldn\'t delete this offline map. Try again.
strings.trash_empty_description: Trips — including photos and checklists — stay here for 30 days before being permanently removed.
strings.trash_retention_info: Trips (including photos & checklists) are kept for 30 days.
strings.trash_hard_delete_confirm_message: Permanently delete \"%1$s\" — including its photos, expenses, and checklist? This action cannot be undone.
strings.trash_hard_delete_confirm_message_fallba: This trip is no longer in the trash.
